drg_rows_2014.name: drg_rows_2014
drg_rows_2014.body_sql:
SELECT
  drg_definition,
  provider_id AS hospital_id,
  provider_city AS city,
  total_discharges,
  average_total_payments AS total_payments
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2014'
  AND total_discharges IS NOT NULL
grain: one row per original source row (DRG x provider row) — row
drg_rows_2014.description: Restrict the dataset to rows from year 2014 and select relevant columns for DRG, hospital location, discharges, and total payments. This is the base cohort for all further aggregation.

drg_total_discharges.name: drg_total_discharges
drg_total_discharges.body_sql:
SELECT
  drg_definition,
  SUM(total_discharges) AS drg_global_discharges
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
GROUP BY drg_definition
drg_total_discharges.description: Compute total discharges summed across all hospitals for each DRG definition (global DRG-level discharges). One row per DRG definition to identify which DRG has the highest overall discharges.

city_aggregates_per_drg.name: city_aggregates_per_drg
city_aggregates_per_drg.body_sql:
SELECT
  drg_definition,
  COALESCE(city, '') AS city,
  SUM(IFNULL(total_discharges, 0)) AS city_total_discharges,
  SUM(IFNULL(total_payments, 0.0)) AS city_sum_total_payments
FROM (
  -- use wildcard inpatient shards across years; caller should set _TABLE_SUFFIX filter when querying the view
  SELECT
    `drg_definition`,
    `provider_city` AS city,
    `total_discharges`,
    `average_total_payments` * IFNULL(`total_discharges`, 0) AS total_payments
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
)
GROUP BY
  drg_definition,
  city
city_aggregates_per_drg.description: For each DRG definition and city, compute the sum of total discharges and the sum of total payments (these sums will be used to calculate city-level weighted averages). One row per DRG definition + city.

top_cities_for_top_drg.name: top_cities_for_top_drg
top_cities_for_top_drg.body_sql:
SELECT
  top_drg.drg_definition AS drg_definition,
  city_aggs.city AS city,
  city_aggs.city_total_discharges AS city_total_discharges,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(city_aggs.city_sum_total_payments, city_aggs.city_total_discharges) AS city_weighted_avg_total_payments
FROM (
  -- find the single DRG with highest global discharges across shards 2011-2015
  SELECT drg_definition
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
  GROUP BY drg_definition
  ORDER BY SUM(total_discharges) DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS top_drg
JOIN (
  -- city-level aggregates per DRG: sum discharges and sum of (avg_total_payments * discharges)
  SELECT
    drg_definition,
    provider_city AS city,
    SUM(total_discharges) AS city_total_discharges,
    SUM(average_total_payments * total_discharges) AS city_sum_total_payments
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
  GROUP BY drg_definition, provider_city
) AS city_aggs
ON city_aggs.drg_definition = top_drg.drg_definition
ORDER BY city_aggs.city_total_discharges DESC
LIMIT 3
top_cities_for_top_drg.description: Select the single DRG definition with the highest drg_global_discharges, then for that DRG pick cities ordered by city_total_discharges descending and compute the weighted average total payments for each city (weight = city_total_discharges). Limit to top 3 cities.

prescriptions_2014.name: prescriptions_2014
prescriptions_2014.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- Use NPI as the primary prescription identifier; when multiple drugs per NPI exist,
  -- combine NPI + drug_name to ensure uniqueness at the prescription (provider-drug) grain.
  CONCAT(npi, '::', drug_name) AS prescription_id,
  nppes_provider_state AS state,
  drug_name AS medication,
  -- The source table does not include an explicit prescription date. Lifted literal for year filter is 2014.
  -- Use NULL for prescription_date because no per-prescription date field exists in this table.
  NULL AS prescription_date
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
WHERE
  -- Filter to records from the 2014 dataset (table is 2014-specific). Keeping a year literal for clarity.
  2014 = 2014
grain: one row per prescription_id (provider NPI + drug_name compound)
prescriptions_2014.description: Filter prescription records to only those in the year 2014 and project the relevant identifiers (state and medication) and a unique prescription identifier if available.

state_medication_counts.name: state_medication_counts
state_medication_counts.body_sql:
SELECT
  nppes_provider_state AS state,
  drug_name AS medication,
  SUM(IFNULL(total_claim_count, 0)) AS prescription_count_2014
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
WHERE
  -- liftable literal: year filter (table is 2014; keep for clarity)
  TRUE
  AND nppes_provider_state IS NOT NULL
  AND drug_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  nppes_provider_state,
  drug_name
state_medication_counts.description: Aggregate the 2014 prescriptions to count how many prescriptions occurred for each medication within each state.

state_max_counts.name: state_max_counts
state_max_counts.body_sql:
SELECT
  smc.state AS state,
  -- lift no literals into view; this computes the max prescription count per state for 2014
  MAX(smc.prescription_count_2014) AS max_prescription_count_2014
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.location` l
JOIN
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person` p
  ON p.location_id = l.location_id
-- use the provided aggregate view of state-medication counts for 2014 as the source of per-medication counts per state
JOIN
  `state_medication_counts` smc
  ON smc.state = l.state
GROUP BY
  smc.state
state_max_counts.description: Compute the maximum prescription count among medications within each state (the per-state highest count) for 2014.

top_medications_per_state.name: top_medications_per_state
top_medications_per_state.body_sql:
SELECT
  agg.state AS state,
  agg.medication AS medication,
  agg.prescription_count_2014 AS prescription_count_2014
FROM (
  -- aggregated prescription counts per state and medication for 2014
  SELECT
    `nppes_provider_state` AS state,
    `drug_name` AS medication,
    SUM(`total_claim_count`) AS prescription_count_2014
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
  GROUP BY `nppes_provider_state`, `drug_name`
) AS agg
JOIN (
  -- per-state maximum prescription count value (lifted literal: none)
  SELECT
    state AS state,
    MAX(prescription_count_2014) AS state_max_prescription_count_2014
  FROM (
    SELECT
      `nppes_provider_state` AS state,
      `drug_name` AS medication,
      SUM(`total_claim_count`) AS prescription_count_2014
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
    GROUP BY `nppes_provider_state`, `drug_name`
  )
  GROUP BY state
) AS max_per_state
ON agg.state = max_per_state.state
AND agg.prescription_count_2014 = max_per_state.state_max_prescription_count_2014
top_medications_per_state.description: Join medication-level counts to the per-state maximums and keep medications whose count equals the state's maximum (this yields one or more top medications per state in 2014).

provider_year_cost_rows.name: provider_year_cost_rows
provider_year_cost_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  provider_id,
  cost_type,
  cost_value,
  '2014' AS year
FROM (
  -- Inpatient cost rows (use average_medicare_payments as the cost value)
  SELECT
    provider_id,
    'inpatient' AS cost_type,
    SAFE_CAST(average_medicare_payments AS FLOAT64) AS cost_value,
    CONCAT('inpatient_', CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY provider_id ORDER BY drg_definition, average_medicare_payments) AS STRING)) AS record_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2014'
  AND average_medicare_payments IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  -- Outpatient cost rows (use average_total_payments as the cost value)
  SELECT
    provider_id,
    'outpatient' AS cost_type,
    SAFE_CAST(average_total_payments AS FLOAT64) AS cost_value,
    CONCAT('outpatient_', CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY provider_id ORDER BY apc, average_total_payments) AS STRING)) AS record_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2014'
  AND average_total_payments IS NOT NULL
)
provider_year_cost_rows.description: Select cost records for the specified year (2014) from cost-related tables (both outpatient and inpatient), keeping provider identifier, cost type (outpatient or inpatient), and the cost value. This is a cohort of raw cost rows filtered to year 2014.

avg_costs_per_provider_and_type.name: avg_costs_per_provider_and_type
avg_costs_per_provider_and_type.body_sql:
SELECT
  CAST(c.cost_id AS STRING) AS provider_id,  -- provider identifier not present; using cost_id as provider proxy (lifted literal: none)
  CASE
    WHEN c.cost_domain_id = 'Procedure' THEN 'inpatient'
    WHEN c.cost_domain_id = 'Drug' THEN 'outpatient'
    ELSE LOWER(c.cost_domain_id)
  END AS cost_type_normalized,
  AVG(COALESCE(c.total_paid, c.total_cost, c.total_charge)) AS avg_cost_2014
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.cost` AS c
WHERE
  TRUE
  -- restrict to 2014 data at query time if using sharded tables; this table is non-sharded so no _TABLE_SUFFIX filter needed
GROUP BY
  provider_id,
  cost_type_normalized
avg_costs_per_provider_and_type.description: Compute the average cost in 2014 for each provider separately for each cost type (outpatient and inpatient). One row per provider per cost type with the average cost.

prescription_events_2014_us_states.name: prescription_events_2014_us_states
prescription_events_2014_us_states.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- drug identifier: use drug_name as observed in the source table
  drug_name AS drug_id,
  -- state identifier: provider state code from Part D prescriber table
  nppes_provider_state AS state_id,
  -- claim count and drug cost preserved from source
  total_claim_count AS claim_count,
  total_drug_cost AS drug_cost,
  -- calendar year literal lifted out of view logic (this view is for 2014)
  2014 AS year,
  -- carry through NPI + drug to preserve joinability at claim-event grain
  npi,
  drug_name AS drug_name_raw
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
WHERE
  -- restrict to US states (50 states + DC). Leave out territories and military codes.
  nppes_provider_state IN (
    'AL','AK','AZ','AR','CA','CO','CT','DE','FL','GA','HI','ID','IL','IN','IA','KS','KY','LA',
    'ME','MD','MA','MI','MN','MS','MO','MT','NE','NV','NH','NJ','NM','NY','NC','ND','OH','OK',
    'OR','PA','RI','SC','SD','TN','TX','UT','VT','VA','WA','WV','WI','WY','DC'
  )
  -- ensure drug identifier and numeric fields are present
  AND drug_name IS NOT NULL
  AND total_claim_count IS NOT NULL
  AND total_drug_cost IS NOT NULL
grain: one row per Part D prescriber/drug claim-event (source row)
prescription_events_2014_us_states.description: All prescription claim events for calendar year 2014 that are located within U.S. states (one row per claim event or claim-line), with drug identifier, state identifier, claim_count, and drug_cost fields preserved.

drug_totals_in_state.name: drug_totals_in_state
drug_totals_in_state.body_sql:
SELECT
  drug_name AS drug_id,                             -- lift drug identifier (use drug_name as drug_id)
  nppes_provider_state AS state_id,                 -- state code
  SUM(IFNULL(total_claim_count, 0)) AS total_claim_count,
  SUM(IFNULL(total_drug_cost, 0.0)) AS total_drug_cost
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
GROUP BY drug_name, nppes_provider_state
drug_totals_in_state.description: Aggregate total claim_count and total drug_cost per drug per state for 2014 by summing claim_count and drug_cost over the prescription events.

drug_totals_in_new_york.name: drug_totals_in_new_york
drug_totals_in_new_york.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- drug identifier: use drug_name as drug_id per exploration showing drug_name identifies drugs in the Part D table
  drug_name AS drug_id,
  -- sum of total_claim_count for prescriptions where provider state is New York (NY) in 2014
  SUM(total_claim_count) AS total_claim_count_ny
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
WHERE
  -- lift state literal out of view definition when querying; here we restrict to NY as requested
  nppes_provider_state = 'NY'
GROUP BY
  drug_name
drug_totals_in_new_york.description: Subset of aggregated drug totals restricted to New York state (one row per drug) to measure total prescriptions per drug in New York during 2014.

top_five_states_for_top_ny_drug.name: top_five_states_for_top_ny_drug
top_five_states_for_top_ny_drug.body_sql:
-- view body: top_five_states_for_top_ny_drug
-- 1) determine the single drug with maximum total_claim_count in NY
-- 2) for that drug, aggregate per-state totals and rank states by total_claim_count
SELECT
  per_state.state_id AS state_id,
  per_state.total_claim_count AS total_claim_count,
  per_state.total_drug_cost AS total_drug_cost,
  per_state.rnk AS `rank`
FROM (
  -- per-state aggregates for the NY-top drug, with ranking
  SELECT
    s.nppes_provider_state AS state_id,
    SUM(s.total_claim_count) AS total_claim_count,
    SUM(s.total_drug_cost) AS total_drug_cost,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.total_claim_count) DESC) AS rnk
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014` AS s
  WHERE s.drug_name = (
    -- drug with maximum total_claim_count in NY (lifted literal: 'NY' can be substituted outside view if needed)
    SELECT drug_name
    FROM (
      SELECT
        drug_name,
        SUM(total_claim_count) AS total_claim_count_in_ny
      FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
      WHERE nppes_provider_state = 'NY'
      GROUP BY drug_name
      ORDER BY total_claim_count_in_ny DESC
      LIMIT 1
    )
  )
  GROUP BY s.nppes_provider_state
) AS per_state
WHERE per_state.rnk <= 5
ORDER BY per_state.rnk
top_five_states_for_top_ny_drug.description: For the single drug that has the maximum total prescriptions in New York (determined from drug_totals_in_new_york), take the per-state aggregates for that drug and rank/order states by their total_claim_count to produce the top five states with their total_claim_count and total_drug_cost.

provider_total_inpatient.name: provider_total_inpatient
provider_total_inpatient.body_sql:
SELECT
  provider_id,
  SUM(
    -- define inpatient cost per record as average_total_payments * total_discharges
    SAFE_MULTIPLY(average_total_payments, CAST(total_discharges AS FLOAT64))
  ) AS total_inpatient_cost_2011_2015
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
GROUP BY provider_id
provider_total_inpatient.description: For each provider compute the total inpatient cost over all years by summing per-record inpatient_cost across 2011-2015 (keeps one row per provider). This will be used to identify the single provider with the maximal total inpatient cost.

participant_medication_records.name: participant_medication_records
participant_medication_records.body_sql:
SELECT
  de.person_id AS participant_id,
  de.drug_exposure_id AS medication_id,
  COALESCE(c.concept_name, de.drug_source_value) AS medication_name,
  -- lift any literal RxCUI lookup out of the view: rxcui is the drug_source_concept_id if present,
  -- otherwise try to parse drug_source_value when it's numeric-ish (kept as string here)
  SAFE_CAST(de.drug_source_concept_id AS STRING) AS rxcui,
  de.drug_exposure_start_date AS record_date,
  -- formulation: prefer info from drug_strength (amount + unit) joined by drug_concept_id,
  -- fallback to NULL if no formulation info
  CASE
    WHEN ds.amount_value IS NOT NULL AND ds.amount_unit_concept_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      CONCAT(CAST(ds.amount_value AS STRING), ' unit_concept_id=', CAST(ds.amount_unit_concept_id AS STRING))
    WHEN ds.numerator_value IS NOT NULL AND ds.numerator_unit_concept_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      CONCAT(CAST(ds.numerator_value AS STRING), '/', CAST(ds.denominator_value AS STRING), ' unit_concept_id=', CAST(ds.numerator_unit_concept_id AS STRING))
    WHEN ds.box_size IS NOT NULL THEN
      CONCAT('box_size=', CAST(ds.box_size AS STRING))
    ELSE NULL
  END AS formulation,
  -- source_flag: indicate which source provided identifiable info useful for quinapril determination
  CASE
    WHEN de.drug_source_concept_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'source_concept'
    WHEN de.drug_source_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'source_value'
    WHEN c.concept_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'standard_concept'
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END AS source_flag
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_exposure` AS de
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept` AS c
  ON de.drug_concept_id = c.concept_id
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_strength` AS ds
  ON de.drug_concept_id = ds.drug_concept_id
WHERE
  -- restrict to records that can be used to determine quinapril usage:
  -- require at least one of: a mapped source concept (likely RxCUI), a non-null source value (name/code), or a standard concept name
  (
    de.drug_source_concept_id IS NOT NULL
    OR de.drug_source_value IS NOT NULL
    OR c.concept_name IS NOT NULL
  )
  -- ensure grain: one row per participant_id, medication_id, record_date
  AND de.person_id IS NOT NULL
  AND de.drug_exposure_id IS NOT NULL
  AND de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
participant_medication_records.description: All medication exposure records for participants (one row per recorded medication usage event or prescription), restricted to records that can be used to determine quinapril usage (i.e., have an RxCUI, medication name, or formulation info).

normalized_medication_terms.name: normalized_medication_terms
normalized_medication_terms.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- key columns / grain
  `person_id` AS participant_id,
  `drug_exposure_id` AS medication_id,
  -- record_date: prefer drug_exposure_start_date, fall back to start_datetime cast, else end date
  COALESCE(
    CAST(`drug_exposure_start_date` AS DATE),
    CAST(`drug_exposure_start_datetime` AS DATE),
    CAST(`drug_exposure_end_date` AS DATE),
    CAST(`drug_exposure_end_datetime` AS DATE)
  ) AS record_date,
  -- medication_name_norm: canonicalize drug_source_value then drug_concept_id as string fallback;
  -- lowercased, trimmed, remove redundant whitespace, remove punctuation except space and slash,
  -- lift any question-specific literals out of view (none here), keep NULLs as NULL
  NULLIF(
    REGEXP_REPLACE(
      TRIM(LOWER(COALESCE(`drug_source_value`, SAFE_CAST(`drug_concept_id` AS STRING)))),
      r"[^a-z0-9/ ]+",
      ""
    ),
    ""
  ) AS medication_name_norm,
  -- rxcui_int: try to coerce drug_source_concept_id (or drug_concept_id) to integer, else NULL.
  -- Keep as INT64 (BigQuery integer). Use NULL for non-positive/0 values if desired by downstream logic.
  CASE
    WHEN `drug_source_concept_id` IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(`drug_source_concept_id` AS INT64)
    WHEN `drug_concept_id` IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(`drug_concept_id` AS INT64)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS rxcui_int,
  -- formulation_norm: normalize available formulation-related fields. Since many fields are empty in observed data,
  -- derive from route_source_value, dose_unit_source_value, and drug_source_value heuristics.
  NULLIF(
    REGEXP_REPLACE(
      TRIM(LOWER(
        COALESCE(
          `route_source_value`,
          `dose_unit_source_value`,
          -- attempt to extract common formulation tokens from drug_source_value (e.g., "tablet", "capsule", "oral"),
          -- naive extraction: keep only words that match common formulation terms
          (SELECT STRING_AGG(token, ' ')
           FROM UNNEST(SPLIT(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(`drug_source_value`, ''), r"[^a-z0-9 ]+", " "), ' ')) AS token
           WHERE token IN ('tablet','tab','tabs','capsule','cap','caps','oral','solution','suspension','injection','inj','patch','cream','ointment','gel','spray','inhaler','drops','chewable','liquid','sr','xr','cr','er','mg','mcg','ml'))
        )
      )),
      r"\s+",
      " "
    ),
    ""
  ) AS formulation_norm
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_exposure`
normalized_medication_terms.description: Normalized/cleaned medication attributes for each medication record: canonicalized lowercased medication_name, coerced RxCUI as integer/null, and normalized formulation strings to enable matching to quinapril mappings.

quinapril_flag_per_record.name: quinapril_flag_per_record
quinapril_flag_per_record.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.person_id AS participant_id,
  de.drug_exposure_id AS medication_id,
  -- use the start date of the drug exposure as the record date
  de.drug_exposure_start_date AS record_date,
  -- flag as quinapril if drug_concept_id (RxCUI) = 35208 OR the drug_source_value or drug_source_concept_id or drug_exposure fields contain 'quinapril'
  -- Note: lift literals out of view; here we test for the numeric RxCUI and lowercase string match
  (CASE
    WHEN de.drug_concept_id = 35208 THEN TRUE
    WHEN LOWER(IFNULL(de.drug_source_value, '')) LIKE '%quinapril%' THEN TRUE
    WHEN LOWER(IFNULL(de.drug_source_value, '')) LIKE '%quinapril%' THEN TRUE
    WHEN LOWER(IFNULL(de.sig, '')) LIKE '%quinapril%' THEN TRUE
    WHEN LOWER(IFNULL(de.route_source_value, '')) LIKE '%quinapril%' THEN TRUE
    ELSE FALSE
  END) AS is_quinapril_record
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person` p
JOIN
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_exposure` de
ON
  p.person_id = de.person_id
quinapril_flag_per_record.description: Apply the business rule that flags a medication record as quinapril-related if rxcui equals 35208 or if the normalized medication name or formulation explicitly indicates 'quinapril' or a related formulation mapped to RxCUI 35208.

storms_2020_north_atlantic.name: storms_2020_north_atlantic
storms_2020_north_atlantic.body_sql:
SELECT
  sid AS storm_id,
  iso_time AS observation_time,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  basin,
  CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM iso_time) AS INT64) AS year
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
WHERE
  basin = 'NA'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM iso_time) = 2020
storms_2020_north_atlantic.description: Select storm-track records limited to storms that occurred in year 2020 and whose basin is North Atlantic. Keep identifying storm id, timestamp/order of observation, and the recorded coordinates (latitude, longitude).

storm_track_ordered_points.name: storm_track_ordered_points
storm_track_ordered_points.body_sql:
-- view body: canonicalize and order hurricane track points into seq_index per storm
SELECT
  sid AS storm_id,
  name AS storm_name,
  iso_time AS observation_time,
  CAST(latitude AS FLOAT64) AS latitude,
  CAST(longitude AS FLOAT64) AS longitude,
  SAFE_CAST(wmo_wind AS INT64) AS max_sustained_wind,
  -- per-storm strict increasing sequence index by observation_time, break ties by ROW_NUMBER over iso_time
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY sid
    ORDER BY iso_time, COALESCE(wmo_wind, -1), COALESCE(wmo_pressure, -1)
  ) AS seq_index
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
WHERE
  sid IS NOT NULL
  AND iso_time IS NOT NULL
  -- ensure numeric lat/lon; filter out clearly invalid values (NULLs kept out so one row per original valid observation)
  AND latitude IS NOT NULL
  AND longitude IS NOT NULL
storm_track_ordered_points.description: Canonicalized and ordered track points per storm: cast types, ensure numeric lat/lon, remove or mark nulls, and produce a strict ordering index per storm (monotonic by observation_time) used for sequential computations. One row per original observation but with a per-storm sequence index.

events_1980_1995.name: events_1980_1995
events_1980_1995.body_sql:
SELECT
  event_id AS event_id,
  CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM event_begin_time) AS INT64) AS event_year,
  state AS state_abbreviation
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1950' AND '2024'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM event_begin_time) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1995
  AND event_id IS NOT NULL
  AND state IS NOT NULL
events_1980_1995.description: Select all storm event records whose event year is between 1980 and 1995 inclusive, keeping the event's year and the state's two-letter postal abbreviation.

stations_period_filter.name: stations_period_filter
stations_period_filter.body_sql:
SELECT
  CONCAT(st.usaf, '-', st.wban) AS station_id,
  PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', st.begin) AS record_start_date,
  -- treat empty or null end as still active (NULL), else parse
  CASE
    WHEN st.`end` IS NULL OR TRIM(st.`end`) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', st.`end`)
  END AS record_end_date,
  -- still_active_flag: 1 if no end date (empty/null) or end >= '2019-06-30', else 0
  CASE
    WHEN st.`end` IS NULL OR TRIM(st.`end`) = '' THEN 1
    WHEN SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', st.`end`) >= DATE '2019-06-30' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS still_active_flag
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` AS st
WHERE
  -- record started on or before 2000-01-01
  SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', st.begin) <= DATE '2000-01-01'
  AND
  -- and remained active through at least 2019-06-30:
  (
    st.`end` IS NULL
    OR TRIM(st.`end`) = ''
    OR SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', st.`end`) >= DATE '2019-06-30'
  )
stations_period_filter.description: Select the cohort of weather stations whose period of record began on or before 2000-01-01 and that remained active through at least 2019-06-30 (either end date >= 2019-06-30 or flagged as still active). Do not aggregate; just filter station-level metadata.

daily_2019_raw.name: daily_2019_raw
daily_2019_raw.body_sql:
SELECT
  CONCAT(stn, "-", wban) AS station_id,
  PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CONCAT(year, LPAD(mo,2,'0'), LPAD(da,2,'0'))) AS obs_date,
  NULLIF(temp, 9999.9) AS temperature,
  NULLIF(max, 9999.9) AS tmax,
  NULLIF(min, 9999.9) AS tmin
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2019'
  AND SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CONCAT(year, LPAD(mo,2,'0'), LPAD(da,2,'0'))) BETWEEN DATE '2019-01-01' AND DATE '2019-12-31'
daily_2019_raw.description: All daily observations for calendar year 2019 (2019-01-01 through 2019-12-31) for all stations, keeping the raw daily fields needed to assess validity (temperature, tmax, tmin) and the observation date.

daily_2019_valid_flag.name: daily_2019_valid_flag
daily_2019_valid_flag.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.station_id AS station_id,
  d.obs_date AS obs_date,
  -- A day is valid if temperature, tmax, and tmin are all present (non-NULL).
  -- Preserve boolean as TRUE/FALSE.
  (d.temperature IS NOT NULL AND d.tmax IS NOT NULL AND d.tmin IS NOT NULL) AS is_valid_day
FROM
  `daily_2019_raw` AS d
daily_2019_valid_flag.description: Normalize/clean 2019 daily rows to produce a per-day validity flag: mark a row as valid if temperature, tmax, and tmin are present/non-missing. Preserve one row per station-date with the boolean valid flag.

station_daily_normalized.name: station_daily_normalized
station_daily_normalized.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- station identifier: prefer concatenated stn-wban when available, else stn alone
  CASE
    WHEN TRIM(stn) != '' AND TRIM(wban) != '' THEN CONCAT(TRIM(stn), '-', TRIM(wban))
    WHEN TRIM(stn) != '' THEN TRIM(stn)
    WHEN TRIM(wban) != '' THEN TRIM(wban)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS station_id,

  -- canonical observation date as DATE
  PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(LPAD(CAST(year AS STRING),4,'0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(mo AS STRING),2,'0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(da AS STRING),2,'0'))) AS observation_date,

  -- split out calendar fields (also available as integers)
  CAST(year AS INT64) AS year,
  CAST(mo AS INT64) AS month,
  CAST(da AS INT64) AS day,

  -- temperature: convert missing sentinel 9999.9 to NULL, values are in Fahrenheit already
  NULLIF(CASE
    WHEN temp IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN SAFE_CAST(temp AS FLOAT64) = 9999.9 THEN NULL
    ELSE SAFE_CAST(temp AS FLOAT64)
  END, NULL) AS temperature,

  -- wind speed: field wdsp may be string; missing sentinel 999.9 -> NULL. Convert to FLOAT.
  NULLIF(CASE
    WHEN wdsp IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) = 999.9 THEN NULL
    ELSE SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64)
  END, NULL) AS wind_speed,

  -- precipitation: prcp uses 99.99 as missing; .00 means zero (valid). Convert to FLOAT.
  NULLIF(CASE
    WHEN prcp IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN SAFE_CAST(prcp AS FLOAT64) = 99.99 THEN NULL
    ELSE SAFE_CAST(prcp AS FLOAT64)
  END, NULL) AS precipitation,

  -- observation timestamp: normalize to a TIMESTAMP at midnight UTC of the obs date (grain is one row per observation day)
  TIMESTAMP(PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(LPAD(CAST(year AS STRING),4,'0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(mo AS STRING),2,'0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(da AS STRING),2,'0')))) AS observation_timestamp

FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`

WHERE
  -- limit shards to the full available range by default; callers should filter _TABLE_SUFFIX externally when creating the view/query
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1929' AND '2024'
  -- exclude rows that cannot produce a valid date
  AND SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64) IS NOT NULL
  AND SAFE_CAST(mo AS INT64) BETWEEN 1 AND 12
  AND SAFE_CAST(da AS INT64) BETWEEN 1 AND 31
station_daily_normalized.description: Normalize and canonicalize measurement fields for each observation: cast temperatures, wind speeds, and precipitation to numeric, handle missing/null markers, and extract the calendar year, month, and day from the observation date.

observations_filtered_years.name: observations_filtered_years
observations_filtered_years.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- station identifier (carry key for joinability)
  '725030' AS station_id,
  -- observation_date as a DATE type constructed from gsod year/mo/da
  PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CONCAT(_TABLE_SUFFIX, LPAD(mo,2,'0'), LPAD(da,2,'0'))) AS observation_date,
  -- year as integer from the shard suffix (gsod year strings)
  CAST(_TABLE_SUFFIX AS INT64) AS year,
  -- temperature: use gsod temp (F) but normalize missing code 9999.9 to NULL
  NULLIF(temp, 9999.9) AS temperature,
  -- wind speed: gsod wdsp is stored as string in some years; cast and treat 999.9 as NULL
  NULLIF(CAST(NULLIF(wdsp, '') AS FLOAT64), 999.9) AS wind_speed,
  -- precipitation: prcp uses 99.99 as missing
  NULLIF(prcp, 99.99) AS precipitation,
  -- observation_timestamp: construct a TIMESTAMP at UTC midnight of the observation date
  TIMESTAMP(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CONCAT(_TABLE_SUFFIX, LPAD(mo,2,'0'), LPAD(da,2,'0')))) AS observation_timestamp
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
WHERE
  -- restrict to station 725030
  (stn = '725030' OR CONCAT(stn, wban) = '725030')  -- try both stn and combined key forms
  -- restrict to month = June (6) and day = 12
  AND CAST(mo AS INT64) = 6
  AND CAST(da AS INT64) = 12
  -- restrict to years 2011 through 2020 inclusive using the table suffix (sharded year)
  AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
  -- keep one row per original observation (GSOD already one row per station-day)
observations_filtered_years.description: Filter the normalized observations to station_id = 725030, month = 6, day = 12, and years in the set 2011..2020 (keep one row per original observation).

source_tables_cohort.name: source_tables_cohort
source_tables_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  _TABLE_SUFFIX AS source_table,
  CAST(FARM_FINGERPRINT(CONCAT(CAST(year AS STRING), '-', CAST(month AS STRING), '-', CAST(day AS STRING), '-', CAST(hour AS STRING), '-', CAST(latitude AS STRING), '-', CAST(longitude AS STRING), '-', IFNULL(callsign, ''))) AS STRING) AS raw_row_id,
  PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(CAST(year AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(month AS STRING),2,'0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(day AS STRING),2,'0'))) AS date,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  -- wind_speed is stored in tenths of m/s per DDL; convert to m/s and compute daily average placeholder per row (lifted literal: keep per-row value)
  SAFE_DIVIDE(wind_speed, 10.0) AS daily_average_wind_speed
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_*`
WHERE
  STARTS_WITH(_TABLE_SUFFIX, 'icoads_core') = FALSE
  OR TRUE
  -- The intent of this view is to include all shards whose table name begins with the prefix 'icoads_core'.
  -- Using the wildcard table above already limits to that pattern; no additional _TABLE_SUFFIX filter is applied here.
source_tables_cohort.description: Select rows from all source tables whose table name starts with the prefix 'icoads_core'. This step isolates candidate observation rows from the relevant source tables before further filtering or projection.

normalized_columns.name: normalized_columns
normalized_columns.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- identify source table exactly as in DDL
  'bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.wind_reports*' AS source_table,
  -- use a stable raw row id: for wildcard tables there is no implicit id, so compose from timestamp + location
  CONCAT(CAST(timestamp AS STRING), '||', IFNULL(location, '')) AS raw_row_id,
  -- normalize date: convert timestamp to DATE; if timestamp is NULL try parsing time string (lifted literal: none)
  DATE(timestamp) AS date,
  -- ensure numeric latitude/longitude (they are FLOAT64 per DDL)
  latitude AS latitude,
  longitude AS longitude,
  -- normalize daily average wind speed: source 'speed' is in miles per hour per DDL.
  -- convert mph to meters/second: 1 mph = 0.44704 m/s. Keep numeric and allow NULLs.
  SAFE_CAST(speed AS FLOAT64) * 0.44704 AS daily_average_wind_speed
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.wind_reports*`
-- NOTE: caller should restrict shards via _TABLE_SUFFIX when querying the view
normalized_columns.description: Normalize and canonicalize output columns: ensure date is in a standard date type, latitude/longitude are numeric, and daily_average_wind_speed is numeric. Keep one row per original observation (no aggregation).

top_daily_average_wind_rows.name: top_daily_average_wind_rows
top_daily_average_wind_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- source table identifier (which underlying table/shard the row came from)
  source_table,
  -- raw row id to keep rows joinable (compose from table + unique identifiers available)
  raw_row_id,
  -- date of the observation (normalized DATE)
  DATE(observation_ts) AS date,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  -- daily average wind speed in meters/second (normalized). Lifted literals: wind speed column name differs by source; view assumes input column 'wind_m_s' exists after normalization step downstream.
  daily_average_wind_speed,
  -- rank of the wind speed per day (dense rank so ties get same rank)
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY daily_average_wind_speed DESC) AS wind_rank
FROM (
  -- Combine normalized wind observation rows from multiple source tables/shards.
  -- This inner union preserves key columns and normalizes timestamp and wind speed to meters/second as 'daily_average_wind_speed'.
  -- Lifted constants: none (units conversion should be handled upstream if needed). Keep identifiers joinable: include table+row unique fields.
  
  -- 1) historic severe storms wind_reports (date-sharded wildcard)
  SELECT
    '`bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.wind_reports*`' AS source_table,
    CONCAT('wind_reports*|', CAST(TIMESTAMP AS STRING), '|', COALESCE(location, ''), '|', COALESCE(CAST(latitude AS STRING), ''), '|', COALESCE(CAST(longitude AS STRING), '')) AS raw_row_id,
    TIMESTAMP AS observation_ts,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    -- wind_reports.speed is in miles per hour; convert to m/s: 1 mph = 0.44704 m/s
    SAFE_DIVIDE(CAST(speed AS FLOAT64) * 0.44704, 1) AS daily_average_wind_speed
  FROM
    `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.wind_reports*`
  WHERE
    _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '' AND ''  -- literal range to be supplied at query time
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- 2) hurricanes table (contains instantaneous observations; use wmo_wind when available)
  SELECT
    '`bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`' AS source_table,
    CONCAT('hurricanes|', COALESCE(sid,''), '|', COALESCE(CAST(iso_time AS STRING),'')) AS raw_row_id,
    iso_time AS observation_ts,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    -- wmo_wind assumed in knots? The dataset documents max sustained wind but not units reliably; assume knots and convert to m/s: 1 knot = 0.514444 m/s
    SAFE_DIVIDE(CAST(wmo_wind AS FLOAT64) * 0.514444, 1) AS daily_average_wind_speed
  FROM
    `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- 3) ICOADS shards (multiple shard patterns). Use wildcard with suffix bounds lifted out.
  SELECT
    '`bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_*`' AS source_table,
    CONCAT('icoads_core_*|', COALESCE(CAST(year AS STRING),''), '-', COALESCE(CAST(month AS STRING),''), '-', COALESCE(CAST(day AS STRING),''), '|', COALESCE(CAST(hour AS STRING),''), '|', COALESCE(CAST(latitude AS STRING),''), '|', COALESCE(CAST(longitude AS STRING),'')) AS raw_row_id,
    -- Construct observation timestamp from year/month/day/hour if possible
    TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(CAST(year AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(month AS STRING),2,'0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(day AS STRING),2,'0'), ' ', LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(hour) AS STRING),2,'0'), ':00:00')) AS observation_ts,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    -- ICOADS often encodes wind in m/s or coded; here assume variable 'wind_speed' in m/s exists or has been normalized upstream.
    SAFE_CAST(NULLIF(NULL, '') AS FLOAT64) AS daily_average_wind_speed
  FROM
    `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_*`
  WHERE
    _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2005' AND '2017'
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- 4) GSOD daily station summary (wind fields like wdsp or mxpsd exist; wdsp is in knots as string)
  SELECT
    '`bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`' AS source_table,
    CONCAT('gsod*|', COALESCE(stn,''), '|', COALESCE(wban,''), '|', year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS raw_row_id,
    -- gsod stores date components as strings year/mo/da
    TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(year,'-',LPAD(mo,2,'0'),'-',LPAD(da,2,'0'),' 00:00:00')) AS observation_ts,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS latitude,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS longitude,
    -- wdsp field is mean wind speed in knots (string); convert to m/s
    SAFE_CAST(REPLACE(wdsp, ' ', '') AS FLOAT64) * 0.514444 AS daily_average_wind_speed
  FROM
    `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE
    _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1929' AND '2024'
)
-- Final projection keeps grain one row per source_table, raw_row_id (assumed unique per source)
top_daily_average_wind_rows.description: Rank or order the normalized observation rows by daily_average_wind_speed descending and select the top rows. This relation will produce the final ordered subset for downstream limiting or presentation.

stations_2022_records.name: stations_2022_records
stations_2022_records.body_sql:
SELECT
  stn AS usaf,
  PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CONCAT(CAST(year AS STRING), LPAD(mo,2,'0'), LPAD(da,2,'0'))) AS date,
  NULLIF(temp, 9999.9) AS temp,
  NULLIF(max, 9999.9) AS max_temp,
  NULLIF(min, 9999.9) AS min_temp
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1929' AND '2024'
  AND CAST(year AS INT64) = 2022
  AND stn IS NOT NULL
  AND stn != '999999'
stations_2022_records.description: All daily observation records from calendar year 2022, excluding records belonging to stations whose USAF code equals the literal '999999'. Keep raw temperature, maximum, minimum, station identifier, and observation date.

stations_in_state.name: stations_in_state
stations_in_state.body_sql:
SELECT
  CONCAT(usaf, IFNULL(NULLIF(wban, ''), '')) AS station_id,
  name AS station_name,
  state
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
WHERE
  state IS NOT NULL
